title: Vehicle-Value Replacement Grace — Collateral Protection Insurance Closing-Period Refund
content:
The closing-period refund under Collateral Protection Insurance grants a vehicle-value replacement grace, set by the vehicle book value on the borrower's Retail Installment Contracts record (the wholesale book value used for loan-to-value at origination).

| Vehicle book value on the contract | Replacement-grace days granted |
|---|---|
| no more than USD 12500.00 | 2 days |
| above USD 12500.00 and no more than USD 18000.00 | 1 day |
| above USD 18000.00 | 0 days |

Boundaries: a book value of USD 12500.00 grants 2 days and USD 12500.01 grants 1; USD 18000.00 grants 1 day and USD 18000.01 grants 0 days.

**Replacement days.** When two or more accepted proofs reach the covered stretch of the refunded charge's period, the replacement days are the days from the start of the earliest reaching span through the end of the latest reaching span that no reaching span covers. A proof reaches the covered stretch when its expiration date falls on or after the period start and it took effect on or before the closed date, and its span runs from the later of the period start and its effective date through the earlier of its expiration date and the closed date. Where the refund is figured pro rata from the proof effective date, the first replacement days count as covered and are refundable days, added to the covered days and the post-closing days; the days this grace grants are added to the number of replacement days that count, which never exceeds the replacement days there are.

**Hypothetical:** two reaching proofs with spans day 1 to day 10 and day 15 to day 30 of a period leave replacement days 11 to 14, four days. With a book value of USD 9000.00 this grace adds 2 days, so days 11 and 12 count as covered.
